contacts.name: Aventurine
contacts.signature: Always open to pull for your game account

202460000.text: The sun's been absolutely brutal in Astropolis lately

202460001.text: Just remembered I've got a foolproof way to beat the heat. Thought I'd share it with you

202460002.text: Does your way of staying cool cost a lot of credits?

202460003.text: Wear less clothing? First off, I don't have a swimsuit

202460004.text: Quite the opposite. It's all about going back to basics

202460005.text: Easy. I'll get you a custom vacation set just like mine sometime

202460006.text: Back in Sigonia, there's this tradition: Find a big enough rock or a shaded dune, lie flat in the shadow, and slow down your breathing

202460007.text: And then there's the sand therapy: Drinking three big cups of freshly boiled, piping hot spiced tea, before burying yourself in the sand

202460008.text: If you can sweat more than the sun can dry up, you'll reach a kind of transcendent, ultimate coolness

202460009.text: Shame I never got the chance to properly try it out during my childhood.

202460010.text: I acted on a whim down at the beach just now. I had some hot tea, closed my eyes, and rested my mind.

202460011.text: If security hadn't kept coming over to check if I'd passed out from the sun, I could've laid there for another half a day.

202460012.text: Did you have to get so fired up? Ten ice-cold sodas can barely cool you down.

202460013.text: I'm sweating just reading this. You owe me a super ice-cold soda to cool me down.

202460014.text: Time to make up for those childhood regrets! Let's go!

202460015.text: I'll get buried in the sand with you! Just buy me ten super ice-cold sodas later to cool me down, and we'll call it even.

202460016.text: Hearing you say that gets me fired up too, friend.

202460017.text: Don't worry, I've got all the ice-cold soda you could ever want.

202460018.text: The brand gifted me 12 million's worth of soda vouchers. It's just impossible to drink all that soda.

202460019.text: Since you brought it up, I'll cover the Astral Express's ice drinks for all the coming summers.

202460021.text: Oh, right. I also found an exclusive little tea house in Astropolis. They serve a tea there that tastes remarkably close to my homeland's tea

202460022.text: When you're free, I'll take you to try it.
